extracted_concepts.name: Arithmetic Sequence
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A sequence with common difference d, a_n = a_1 + (n-1)d.

extracted_concepts.name: Arithmetic Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Sum of arithmetic sequence terms, S_n = n/2[2a_1 + (n-1)d].

extracted_concepts.name: Geometric Sequence
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A sequence with common ratio r, a_n = a_1 r^(n-1).

extracted_concepts.name: Geometric Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Sum of geometric sequence terms, S_n = a_1(1-r^n)/(1-r).

extracted_concepts.name: Infinite Geometric Series
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Sum to infinity S_inf = a_1/(1-r) when |r| < 1.

extracted_concepts.name: Laws of Exponents
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Rules such as a^m a^n = a^(m+n) and (a^m)^n = a^(mn).

extracted_concepts.name: Logarithm
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: log_a(x) = y if and only if a^y = x.

extracted_concepts.name: Change of Base Formula
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: log_a(x) = log_b(x)/log_b(a).

extracted_concepts.name: Complex Number
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A number z = a + bi where i^2 = -1.

extracted_concepts.name: Modulus of Complex Number
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: |z| = sqrt(a^2 + b^2) for z = a + bi.

extracted_concepts.name: Argument of Complex Number
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: arg(z) is the angle of z, often arctan(b/a).

extracted_concepts.name: Polar Form of Complex Number
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: z = r(cos theta + i sin theta).

extracted_concepts.name: Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A mapping from inputs to outputs with domain and range.

extracted_concepts.name: Quadratic Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: f(x) = ax^2 + bx + c.

extracted_concepts.name: Discriminant
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Delta = b^2 - 4ac for a quadratic function.

extracted_concepts.name: Rational Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function of the form f(x) = P(x)/Q(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Exponential Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function of the form f(x) = a^x.

extracted_concepts.name: Logarithmic Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function of the form g(x) = log_a(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Natural Exponential Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The exponential function f(x) = e^x.

extracted_concepts.name: Natural Logarithm
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The logarithm with base e, written ln(x).

extracted_concepts.name: Radian Measure
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Angle measure where arc length s = r theta.

extracted_concepts.name: Arc Length
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: s = r theta for central angle theta in radians.

extracted_concepts.name: Sector Area
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A = 1/2 r^2 theta for angle theta in radians.

extracted_concepts.name: Trigonometric Function
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Functions such as sin x, cos x, and tan x.

extracted_concepts.name: Pythagorean Trigonometric Identity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: sin^2 x + cos^2 x = 1.

extracted_concepts.name: Double Angle Formulas
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Formulas such as sin 2x = 2 sin x cos x.

extracted_concepts.name: Vector
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A quantity with magnitude and direction.

extracted_concepts.name: Dot Product
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: a · b = |a||b| cos theta.

extracted_concepts.name: Cross Product
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: |a × b| = |a||b| sin theta in 3D.

extracted_concepts.name: Limit
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The value approached by a function as the input approaches a point.

extracted_concepts.name: Continuity
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: A function is continuous when its graph has no breaks.

extracted_concepts.name: Differentiation
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The process of finding a derivative from first principles or rules.

extracted_concepts.name: Integration
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: The process of finding indefinite or definite integrals.

extracted_concepts.name: Fundamental Theorem of Calculus
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Connects differentiation and integration.

extracted_concepts.name: Probability
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Measure of the likelihood of events in a sample space.

extracted_concepts.name: Conditional Probability
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Probability of an event given another event has occurred.

extracted_concepts.name: Bayes' Theorem
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Relates conditional probabilities to update probabilities.
